description: Analyze a fintech company's financials, risk profile, and regulatory history by stock ticker (e.g., "AAPL"). Returns SEC filings, income statements, stock quotes, consumer complaints, and company overview. A retired or reassigned ticker returns found:false with empty_reason ticker_not_current and the nearest company-name candidates, never a different company.

_avKey.description: Alpha Vantage API key (optional, for stock/financial data)

_fredKey.description: FRED API key (optional, for macro context)

name: fintech_company_deep_dive

candidates.description: Nearest company-name matches (ticker, company_name, cik); name guesses, not the company asked about

cik.description: SEC CIK lookup result or null if unavailable

company_overview.description: Company fundamentals and overview or null if unavailable

consumer_complaints.description: CFPB consumer complaints or null if unavailable

empty_reason.description: ticker_not_current: the symbol matched only a company name, so nothing was looked up

found.description: Present and true on an answer; a miss is the found:false branch.

income_statement.description: Income statement financials or null if unavailable

macro_context.description: Macro economic context or null if FRED key not provided

sec_filings.description: SEC 10-K filings data or null if unavailable

stock_quote.description: Current stock quote data or null if unavailable

oneOf.description: A miss or an unavailable upstream: found:false with a reason and a hint (the shape check-found-false-schemas.mjs expects).

title: Fintech Company Deep Dive
